component.name: QT_llama.cpp
component.summary: Multimodal Vision, Desktop Control, Browser Automation & General AI Agent for llama.cpp

description.p: QT_llama.cpp is an autonomous, general-purpose agent and vibe-coding assistant powered by in-process llama.cpp and Gemma 4 models. It features rich multimodal understanding, headless browser automation with Chrome DevTools Protocol, desktop screenshot analysis, media processing, and automated workspace tools.

ul.li: Autonomous tool orchestration and multi-step turn planning
Full headless Chromium browser automation (Brave/Chromium/Chrome) and web search
Desktop visual perception and GUI control
Speech synthesis (TTS) and microphone audio recording
Smart context management and auto-compaction for long tasks

description.p: Pure Linux release with Qt6 support, headless Chromium CDP automation, Flatpak packaging on Freedesktop SDK 24.08, and automated updates.
